'''Solwyn Tamm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], who was a student at the [[Dorumaa Research Institute]] on [[Dorumaa]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
He once traveled with the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in a submarine, to observe the two [[Dorumaan leviathan]]s, [[Jessel]] and [[Titon]]. However they discovered that Jessel had been stolen and they tried to find the creature. They also rescued the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[A. Rahring]] and he and Tamm disagreed over their scientific views on the leviathans. They were later able to free Jessel and they traveled back to [[Greentree Pointe]].
